nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can the proposed methodology benefit policy and decision-makers?
nodes.answer: The proposed methodology facilitates the identification of the most vulnerable urban sites, providing essential insights for targeted interventions to enhance urban resilience.

nodes.question: What are the key contributions of Smart City solutions and technologies in enhancing resilience against the COVID-19 pandemic according to the literature review by Sharif et al. (2021)?
nodes.answer: According to the literature review by Sharif et al. (2021), Smart City solutions and technologies have been found to contribute significantly to resilience against the COVID-19 pandemic by enabling better crisis management, remote work and learning, contact tracing, and public health monitoring.
